title: ヤエノムテキの見取り稽古

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A young girl comes over to talk to Yaeno Muteki as she does her pre-training routine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hngh… Such an adorable youngster… I must keep her safe from harm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But it's almost time for training… How am I to address this dilemma?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I know! I can teach her self-defense techniques!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join me for some martial arts practice?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A fine reply! In that case, try copying my movements!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ohh, you have potential. I may have stumbled upon a master in the making here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While demonstrating techniques for the little girl, Yaeno Muteki loses track of time and ends up missing her own training entirely.
